summary: The 12 Nov Akhbar Libya 24 report says Yefren residents held protest vigils rejecting outside military/security intervention and demanding armed groups leave. It does not give the vigil date, turnout or end; the report links them to the same Yefren security crisis as the 24 Oct episode. Treat as possible continuation, not a new November-onset event.
open_questions: Were the November vigils distinct new gatherings or continuation of the 24 Oct episode?
Can a permitted source establish exact date(s), simultaneous attendance and closure?
